thread:
Maya: Heads up — a demo customer (acct: lumen-demo) is running a live walkthrough in us-west2 and we're seeing sustained admission control kicks. Queue depth spiked to ~220 requests and latency for small-chat models is 12-18s. Can we do a temporary override?
Tim: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the job ids and the model variant? Is this hosted or dedicated?
Maya: Hosted. Model: tiny-chat-v2-quant, route: /v1/chat/generation, sample ids: 98712,98713,98714. It looks like long context sessions (20–30s token streams) from the demo harness are holding KV caches open.
Alex: Confirming admission control is throttling the queue. We hit concurrency cap on west2-pool-3 (NVIDIA A100s) and backpressure is causing queueing. Current policy: per-account concurrency 50, global pool concurrency 600. That account is bursty — some sessions spawn many parallel requests.
sre-bot: [alert] 2026-03-19T14:32:10Z west2-pool-3 queue_depth=222 admission_rejects=46 avg_wait=9.8s
Jordan: This is a sales demo — high priority for conversion. How long of an override are we asking? Customer insists on low-latency demo for next 45 minutes.
Maya: Asking for a 1-hour temporary concurrency bump from 50 -> 120 for lumen-demo in us-west2. We understand cost hit but want to avoid losing the opportunity.
Tim: Two options: (A) temporary per-account concurrency override (fast, soft limit) — low risk, manual approval from infra lead; (B) route traffic to eu-west1 fallback where capacity exists — but cross-region demo not allowed due to data residency for this customer.
Alex: Also could adjust admission policy: prefer shorter-lived sessions by lowering per-connection token retention (reduce KV cache TTL) for that route, which would free slots but may increase generation costs. That's a config change and needs runtime rollout (~20m).
Lia: Finance — quick note: if we do the bump, estimated incremental spend ~ $480 for the hour (A100 runtime + egress buffer). Jordan, confirm if sales will cover or convert?
Jordan: Sales can approve demo carry for this prospect. Proceed if SRE/Infra OK.
Tim: I can approve the per-account override for 1 hour. @Alex can you run the temporary change and monitor, and revert after 1h? Also add a one-off admission cap label so billing flags the delta.
Alex: On it. I'll apply override now and push a short-lived admission rule: account:lumen-demo concurrency=120 expires=3600s. Starting at 14:36 UTC. Will post metrics in 5m.
sre-bot: [action] applied override account:lumen-demo concurrency=120 expires=3600s by Alex
Maya: Demo team says latency dropped to ~2.1s median immediately, thanks team :tada:
Alex: Monitoring: queue_depth down to 18, admission_rejects=0, avg_wait=0.6s. Leaving override in place for 1 hour and will auto-revert.
Tim: Postmortem action: we should add a self-service short-burst flow in Console for verified sales/demo accounts to avoid manual escalations. Filing follow-up ticket.
Jordan: Please add follow-up: Sales -> register demo windows in calendar with support 24h prior.
Maya: Noted. Closing thread once override expires. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
